data.title: O Coração de Éter (tema de título)
data.style: 16-bit SNES-era JRPG title theme, epic and nostalgic, slow majestic orchestral intro with music box and harp, then soaring strings and french horns with a memorable heroic melody, subtle clockwork percussion, bittersweet and hopeful, like classic 90s JRPG opening themes, major key with melancholic minor passages, 80 BPM, seamless loop
